opening.argument: The video presents a straightforward giveaway: four $25 gift cards are offered, and the speaker visibly holds up a card. Entry calls for liking a Facebook page, subscribing to a YouTube channel, sharing the post, and tagging two friends. Those are ordinary social-media participation conditions, not requests for money or sensitive personal data, and the record shows no separate deceptive transaction flow. The available evidence does not establish whether winners were selected or received the cards, so the conclusion rests on the offer and entry terms shown, not on a claimed outcome.

citations.quote: Giving away FOUR $25 gift cards to four random winners!
